observed_problem: A Review Finding could previously claim CLOSED based on its own fields without proving inclusion in a validated/closed Repair Set.
expected_behavior: Finding closure is governed by Repair Set authority; standalone CLOSED findings fail validation and closure requires a matching closed Repair Set context.
actual_behavior: A Finding could bypass repair-set validation and appear fully resolved without machine-readable repair authority.
improvement_action: Require Repair Set closure authority for CLOSED Findings and validate the Finding/Repair Set relationship fail-closed.
